description: Big N in each column header equals the analysis-population count in ADSL (Safety: SAFFL='Y' by TRT01A).
Demographic and safety tables are built on the Safety Population.
The same N is used for a treatment group in every Safety Population table.
Baseline is defined per treatment period: ABLFL='Y' in each period a subject has records in.
Analysis visits use the SAP windows (Baseline up to Day 1, Week 4 22-35, Week 8 50-63).
TEAE is onset on or after first dose and on or before last dose + 7 days (TRTEMFL).
Printed percentages are n divided by the column Big N, shown to one decimal place.
The Total column equals the sum of the treatment arms.
A subject is counted once per SOC and once per PT, so a SOC count is at least its largest PT.
Every table in the SAP table inventory is delivered.
